title: Local Advertising Google: Smart Growth for Small Business

facts.fact: The article says local advertising on Google has three main paths: Local Services Ads, search ads with location information, and Performance Max campaigns with store goals.
facts.quote: **Local advertising on Google has three main paths:** Local Services Ads help eligible service businesses get calls and messages, with charges based on leads.

facts.fact: The article states that Local Services Ads charge based on leads rather than clicks.
facts.quote: Local Services Ads help eligible service businesses get calls and messages, with charges based on leads.

facts.fact: The article's author, Tomasz Lasota, says he has more than 22 years of experience helping businesses grow through Google Ads, local SEO, and websites built to convert (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: I draw on more than 22 years of experience helping businesses grow through Google Ads, local SEO, and websites built to convert.

facts.fact: The page states that the author's firm, WWS - Web Development + SEO, is located in Des Plaines.
facts.quote: I’m Tomasz Lasota, founder of WWS - Web Development + SEO in Des Plaines.

facts.fact: The page lists its business hours as Monday to Friday 8:30 AM to 8:00 PM and Saturday 9 am to 3 pm.
